Phone No.: 9096880462 | Email: paragawaken@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Data Analyst & Data Modelling professional with 12+ years of experience delivering large-scale data transformation programs across Capital Markets, Risk, and Regulatory Reporting domains. Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling, data reconciliation, metadata analysis, and Snowflake-based analytical solutions

Experienced in working within Agile, cross-functional team to elicit, analyze, and validate business, functional, and non-functional requirements, translating them into high-quality data models and governed data solutions.. Proven ability to support development teams with data modeling artifacts, source-to-target mappings, and lineage documentation aligned with enterprise data governance standards

CORE SKILLS

Data Analysis & Analytics

• Data Profiling & Data Quality Analysis • •

SQL (complex joins, aggregations, reconciliation queries)

Excel (advanced formulas, reconciliation models) Power BI (data validation, reporting, dashboards)

Data Modeling & Architecture

Conceptual, Logical & Physical Data Models (C/L/P)

Entity-Relationship Modeling (ERDs)

Dimensional & Transactional Modeling

Schema Design & Optimization

JSON & Semi-Structured Data Modeling

Metadata, Governance & Lineage

Entity & Attribute Definitions

Naming Standards & Data Dictionaries

Data Types, Lengths, Constraints

Source-to-Target Mapping (STTM)

Data Lineage & Impact Analysis

Data Platforms & Tools

Snowflake(analytical storage, transformations, reconciliation support)

SQL-based data validation & reconciliation

Lucidchart, Balsamiq (data & process diagrams)

Jira, Azure DevOps

Agile Data Delivery

Agile / Scrum / Kanban

User Stories & Acceptance Criteria (Data-focused)

Backlog Refinement for Data Requirements

Sprint Planning & Delivery Support

Domain Expertise

Capital Markets & Trade Processing

Credit Risk, Market Risk, Stress Testing

Regulatory Reporting (MiFID II, ESMA,

EDUCATION

Master of Commerce. Modern College, Pune University

CERTIFICATIONS

NSE’s Certification in Financial Markets (NCFM) – Equity Derivatives: A Beginner’s Module • •

Product Manager Course Pursuing UI/UX designer course from UDEMY: Gaining hands-on experience in UI/UX principles, wire framing, prototyping and user research ISTQB Certified Currently Pursuing: CSPO Certification from Scrum Alliance**Data Analysis & Analytics**



PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE: Tata Consultancy Services(TCS), Pune (May 2021 – Present) Designation: Consultant, Senior IT Data Analyst (BFSI-Capital Markets)

Key Projects in Mortage, Capital Markets/Credit ,Risk & Regulatory Compliance

1. Data Analyst – Market Risk/Stress Testing | Credit Suisse Recovery & Resolution Planning (RRP) Project | ESMA,FINMA and BRRD Regulatory Compliance

Led the end-to-end design and delivery of regulatory RRP reports, ensuring compliance with ESMA and BRRD directive for capital and Recovery & Resolution planning.

Supported large-scale regulatory data transformation** initiatives for Recovery & Resolution Planning (RRP).

Designed and maintained logical and physical data modelsto support stress testing, wind-down analysis, and regulatory reporting.

Translated complex regulatory and business requirements into structured data models and reconciliation logic.

Performed data profiling and validation on upstream risk, pricing, and exposure datasets.

Conducted reconciliation analysis between source systems and regulatory outputs to ensure accuracy and auditability.

Created data dictionaries, entity definitions, and lineage documentation aligned with governance standards.

Worked in Agile delivery teams, supporting sprint planning, story grooming, and data-related acceptance criteria.

2. Business Data Analyst | London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Trade Echo Application | MiFID II Regulatory Reporting

Acted as a key liaison between business and technical teams for the Trade Echo platform, ensuring alignment with MiFID II post-trade transparency requirements.

Gathered, analyzed, and documented business and regulatory requirements for trade reporting, order flows, and transaction publication.

Collaborated with compliance and development teams to implement changes for accurate trade reporting and transparency under MiFID II guidelines.

Participated in functional testing and validation of regulatory reporting workflows to ensure data integrity and compliance.

3. Business & Data Analyst – Mortgage Domain (MISMO Standards) PennyMac

Played a key role in mortgage data standardization by designing and implementing MISMO-compliant data models to support regulatory reporting, investor requirements, and enterprise data strategy. Partnered with stakeholders, architects, and cross-functional teams to improve data governance, lineage, and overall quality.

Designed and implemented MISMO v3.x compliant data models (conceptual, logical, physical), improving scalability and reusability while reducing redundancy by 30%.

Translated business requirements into reusable MISMO-compliant models, enabling faster system integration and accelerating project delivery by 20%.

Validated and optimized source-to-target data mapping across legacy and modern systems, enhancing data quality, consistency, and regulatory compliance by 25%.

Built and maintained data dictionaries, metadata repositories, and schema diagrams, strengthening data governance and reducing onboarding time for new analysts by 40%.

Incorporated evolving MISMO standards into enterprise data strategy, cutting technical rework by 15% and ensuring long-term compliance.

Key Contributions: Lead product strategy and roadmap execution for BFSI-capital markets solutions.

• Define and prioritize user stories and backlog to optimize product delivery. • Drive stakeholder engagement by aligning business goals with technology solutions. • Conduct JAR/JAD sessions for requirement gathering and business alignment. • Collaborate with developers and stakeholders to define API integration requirements • Oversee Product Change Governance (Risk, Dependencies, Security Assessment, Business Readiness). • Perform GAP analysis, create wireframes, and document AS-IS & TO-BE processes. Facilitate Agile ceremonies, ensuring successful Sprint Planning and Execution. • Virtusa Consulting Services Ltd, Pune (May 2018 – May 2021) Designation: Lead Consultant – Business Analysis & Product Mgmt. Key Project: Capital Markets-Middle Office Trade Processing & New Asset Class Integration |Citibank Worked as a Business Analyst in the Capital Markets domain, enhancing middle-office trade validation and processing frameworks to support new asset classes. Analyzed existing trade schemas and data models, defined validation rules, and optimized post-trade workflows for improved STP rates and reduced exceptions. Collaborated with Front Office, Operations, and Technology teams to onboard new instruments and align trade data with regulatory and downstream reporting systems. Key Achievements:

Designed trade validation logic and data mapping for new asset classes (e.g., Fixed Income Derivatives, FX). Enhanced schema definitions and target mappings to support trade enrichment and booking accuracy. Led product enhancements for Global Fund Services Trade Processing.





Defined functional requirements and collaborated with IT teams for implementation

Reduced manual trade validation effort by 40% and improved STP rate through process automation

Northern Trust Operating Services Pvt Ltd, Pune (Aug 2017 – May 2018) Designation: Consultant

Key Contributions:



Led trade reconciliation processes between Hedge Fund clients and Northern Trust (as Custodian), ensuring accuracy and timely resolution of trade breaks.

Collaborated with operations and technology teams to identify reconciliation gaps, streamline workflows, and enhance trade validation efficiency.

Played a key role in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) — prepared test cases, validated new features, and coordinated defect resolution before production rollout.



Supported change implementation for new system features and process enhancements, ensuring minimal business disruption and compliance with operational standards.

Performed daily trade and position validations, monitored exceptions, and implemented automation improvements to enhance reporting accuracy and turnaround time.

Wipro Ltd, Pune (Jan 2010 – Aug 2017) Designation: Lead Analyst –– Investment Banking Operations

Key Contributions:



Supported multiple investment banking operations projects, focusing on trade processing, reconciliation, and process optimization.



Led process migration from the U.S. to India for the Soft Dollar Commission Management function, establishing end-to-end operational workflows and knowledge transfer documentation.

Managed trade reconciliation (Purchase & Sales) across multiple asset classes, ensuring accuracy between front-office and back-office systems.

Collaborated with business and technology teams to analyze trade breaks, identify root causes, and implement preventive controls.

Actively participated in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements — created test scenarios, validated business rules, and supported change deployments.

Worked closely with onshore stakeholders to ensure smooth transition of new business processes and maintain adherence to compliance and audit standards.

Contributed to continuous improvement initiatives that enhanced operational efficiency and reduced reconciliation errors.

DECLARATION

I, Parag Deshpande, hereby solemnly declare that the above information is true to the best of my knowledge and belief.

(P DESHPANDE)
